content.content:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolveResponse'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySunid
      summary: Node by public SUNID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:

answers.answer:
Supported relationship (SCOPe 2.08, the current release): the ornithine decarboxylase (ODC) N-terminal 'wing' domain (family c.23.1.4; protein node sunid 52253), the N-terminal domain of KaiA (family c.23.1.5; family node 82344, protein node 82345), and the CheY-type response regulators (family c.23.1.1, e.g., E. coli and T. maritima CheY species nodes 52175 and 52177) all sit in superfamily c.23.1 'CheY-like' (sunid 52172). That superfamily is in fold c.23 'Flavodoxin-like' (sunid 52171) and class c (alpha/beta). The shared lineage is therefore a superfamily-level structural and evolutionary grouping: a common three-layer alpha/beta-sandwich architecture with a parallel beta-sheet core. Homology claims should stay at the superfamily level. SCOPe does not establish family-level or closer homology among the three families, and it does not establish a common function.

Not supported by this classification: (1) That the ODC wing is a phosphoreceiver or regulates phosphorylation. Its SCOPe description is only the ODC N-terminal wing; the catalytic PLP-dependent activity sits in the ODC major domain (c.67.1.5) and the C-terminal domain (d.125.1.1), so SCOPe assigns no catalytic role to the wing. (2) That the KaiA N-terminal domain is a CheY-like phosphorelay receiver or transfers CheY-type phosphoryl signals. A CheY-like fold alone does not show a conserved phosphoacceptor Asp or a working phospho-relay, and it does not transfer KaiC/KaiB clock-signaling function. (3) That the three domains share a catalytic or signaling mechanism, or that CheY (or any receiver) function transfers to them.

Required external evidence for any signaling or catalytic claim: experimental data such as biochemical assays, site-directed mutagenesis of the candidate residues, and structures of the relevant complexes. Representative selection matters: domains such as d1r8ja2 and d1m2ea_ (KaiA, c.23.1.5) and the ODC wing node should be checked individually, since only sampled structures are represented here. Use release 2.08 identifiers and note that the API describes periodic updates without immutable snapshots.
